India Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia, Citing Regional Stability

India has condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, stating that these actions undermine regional stability. The attacks have also raised concerns regarding the safety of the Bab-el-Mandeb shipping lane. In response to the escalating tensions, the United States has issued an advisory recommending that its citizens reconsider travel to Saudi Arabia.
